features.label: Started as property
features.detail: Born enslaved and crippled by it. The doctrine of inner freedom comes from a man who had no other kind available.

features.label: Never wrote a word
features.detail: Everything survives through a student's lecture notes. You are reading a classroom, not a book.

features.label: Brutally unsentimental
features.detail: No comfort is offered anywhere. The tone is closer to a drill instructor than a sage.
